verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents its own pieces of this story: a code editor alongside the visual editor, Design Studio APIs in its OpenAPI spec, and transactional API calls that pass data to populate messages (variable substitution). The evidence does not show HTML/MJML templates kept as source files, or any git/version-control sync of templates. The CLI's general workspace access does not specifically cover template management. missing for 10: documented HTML/MJML template-as-code workflow, explicit template CRUD endpoints, version-control integration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage email templates as code — HTML/MJML or API-managed templates with variable substitution — under version control

citations.quote: Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path
When you call the API, you can include data that you want to populate in your message, like a password reset URL or the purchase data.
